## Change

Describe what this changes and which area it addresses (architecture, lab, Dockerfile/Compose example, security, CI/CD, or interview content).

## Verification

- [ ] `python3 scripts/check.py` passes
- [ ] Any changed Dockerfile builds successfully (`docker build .`)
- [ ] Any changed Compose/stack file passes `docker compose config`
- [ ] Any new lab includes objective, prerequisites, steps, verification, and cleanup
- [ ] No employer, customer, account, credential, or unwanted personal information is included
- [ ] Links between docs are accurate and were checked
